subject: Stratify enterprise activation — feature gating & audit export prioritization
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-04T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Stratify activation ask — tenant gating + audit export (MAAP attached)

Soojin / Marissa —

Following up from yesterday's call with Stratify (Elaine & Marcus). They are locking their procurement milestone and have two gating asks that are blocking contract signature:

1) Tenant-level feature gating (admin UI + API) so they can control feature rollout per customer tenant.
2) A nightly audit export that contains request metadata (timestamp, route, model, tenant-id) for their compliance team — must exclude full prompt/PII fields for legal reasons.

They've pushed the target go-live to the week of 2027-08-22 if we can commit to a prioritized delivery schedule. I attached the MAAP they sent (Stratify_MAAP_v3.pdf) and the initial security questionnaire they returned.

Can Product/Eng confirm feasibility and an indicative timeline? From sales: we need a clear acceptance criteria for each item so Stratify's legal can sign off. If we can break this into a two-phase delivery (gating API + minimal UI first; export v1 later) that would be ideal.

Next steps we need from you:
- High-level feasibility (shipable by 8/22 or not)
- Minimum acceptance criteria for phase 1
- Any security blockers (Aditya, looping you)

Thanks — I'll sync with Stratify after we have internal alignment.

Attachment: Stratify_MAAP_v3.pdf (MAAP + timeline)
Attachment: security_questionnaire_stratify.xlsx

Best,
Priyom
Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stratify activation ask — tenant gating + audit export (MAAP attached)

Thanks Priyom — good summary. Tagging Product (Jordan) and Eng (Ben) for technical assessment, and Aditya for security review. My proposal: approach this as a scoped, two-sprint effort with clear must-haves for Phase 1.

Priyom: can you confirm the exact fields Stratify needs in the export (they said no raw prompt text) and whether a daily CSV dump meets their compliance (or do they need streaming access / S3 push)? That affects the implementation.

Jordan / Ben: please weigh in on the work and whether we can commit to a targeted delivery window of 2027-08-22 for Phase 1 (gating API + admin toggle). If not, please propose the earliest feasible date and what tradeoffs (UI vs API-first) would reduce scope.

If we can ship an API with a simple admin console and a v1 export (redacted/pseudonymized) within two sprints, Sales can take that back to Stratify and negotiate a short extension on the procurement milestone.

Link to proposed acceptance criteria doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeF_Strategy_MAAP/edit

— Soojin
Director, Product Management
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-04T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stratify activation ask — tenant gating + audit export (MAAP attached)

Quick technical readout after a short sync with Ben:

- Tenant-level gating: API-first approach is feasible in one sprint if we scope it to:
  * Admin API to set per-tenant feature flags (on/off)
  * Runtime check in routing layer (low-effort, existing policy hooks)
  * Minimal admin console (read-only view + toggle) as a separate UI sprint or we can ship simple feature in console that uses existing RBAC components.

- Audit export: complexity depends on retention/redaction rules. We can produce a nightly CSV export (export_schema_v1.csv attached) with the following fields: timestamp, request_id, model_name, route, tenant_id, latency_ms, token_count. No prompt body.
  * If Stratify requires identity mapping or hashed prompt fingerprints, that's additional work (hashing + salt management).
  * Pseudonymization / redaction for PII can be approximate; thorough redaction (NLP-based) is non-trivial and will push timeline.

Estimate (engineer-days):
- Phase 1 (API gating + runtime checks + nightly export v1): ~8-12 dev days + QA + infra config — targetable in ~10 business days if we deprioritize the admin UI.
- Phase 2 (admin UI polish + export S3 push + optional hashing): additional 7-10 days.

Risks:
- Export schema changes requested late will cause rework for infra/analytics.
- Security requirements around export delivery (signed S3, encryption at rest) need Aditya sign-off.

If Sales can accept API-first with a light admin console later, we can meet a go/no-go by 2027-08-18 (internal delivery to Staging) to support Stratify's 8/22 milestone.

Attachment: export_schema_v1.csv

— Jordan
Product Engineering
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-05T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stratify activation ask — tenant gating + audit export (MAAP attached)

Looping in security notes. We can support a nightly export with fields Jordan listed, but we need clarity on two items before sign-off:

1) Delivery mechanism: will this be pushed to an S3 bucket owned by Stratify (preferred) with bucket policy and server-side encryption, or will Redwood place exports in our customer-managed bucket? The former is simpler for us.
2) PII/Prompt policy: Stratify must confirm they do not want raw prompt text under any circumstance. If we must include any free-text fields, we need an approved retention & redaction approach and a stronger DLP pattern.

Compliance-wise (SOC2), the nightly CSV with no prompt bodies and with encryption-in-transit+at-rest plus access logs is acceptable for an initial attestation. We'll require the updated security_questionnaire_stratify.xlsx answers for final scope.

If Sales accepts the S3-push (Stratify-owned) + redacted export v1, Security can sign off on the phased plan.

— Aditya
Security Engineering
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@stratify.io>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@stratify.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-06T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stratify activation ask — tenant gating + audit export (MAAP attached)

Thanks team — this is actionable and much appreciated.

Summary / Agreed path:
- Sales will take an API-first commitment to Stratify: tenant gating API + runtime enforcement. Admin UI will follow in Phase 2.
- Security will accept nightly CSV export v1 (fields per export_schema_v1.csv) delivered to a Stratify-owned S3 bucket with SSE and access logs. No prompt bodies will be included.
- Dev timeline: target internal staging delivery by 2027-08-18, so Stratify can validate ahead of their 8/22 milestone. Jordan / Ben to confirm sprint allocation by EOD 8/6.

Priyom: I've updated the MAAP with the two-phase plan (attached updated MAAP). I'll send Stratify the revised timeline and acceptance criteria after Jordan confirms capacity. Elaine/Marcus — please confirm the S3 bucket approach works for your compliance team or if you require a different delivery pattern.

Attachments: Stratify_MAAP_v3.pdf (updated); security_questionnaire_stratify.xlsx

— Priyom
Sales, Redwood Inference
